title: The bounded below derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset is equivalent to the full subcategory of complexes supported there
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file local-cohomology.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The counted statement identifies the bounded below derived category of modules supported in a specialization-stable subset with the full subcategory of the bounded below derived category of all modules consisting of the complexes supported there (author lemma at source lines 1019-1024, label lemma-equal-plus). The proof (source lines 1026-1052) first proves that every module with support in T admits an injective resolution whose terms again have support in T, which rests on the structure of injective modules over a Noetherian ring and on the explicit computation of the zeroth local cohomology of an injective hull (proof lines 1027-1040), and then uses the spectral sequence of the composite functor to deduce that the derived zeroth local cohomology is an isomorphism on the whole bounded below subcategory (proof lines 1042-1051). The injective-resolution step is the content. H2.
